note: Medicine Bow NF (Snowy Range) campground at 9,200 ft in lodgepole pine and spruce, off Sand Lake Road (FR 101) 1.7 mi from WY 130 west of Centennial, beside the North Fork of the Little Laramie River; North Fork Trail #390 starts at the campground. Three loops; some sites along the river. --Claude
summary: Medicine Bow NF, rec.gov 231846: 60 back-in sites (Center/North/South loops), RV up to 45 ft (min 30), $20 (2026), mix of reservable (9 in catalog) and FCFS, 14-day limit, vault toilets, hand-pump water Jul-Sep. Stored season closes 09-19 cleared (end of reservations; FCFS ran to 10-13 in 2026). FS says 10 sites are along the river - not shown on imagery (canopy), not waterfront kept as a lead. Pin ~160 m from the site centroid - no move. Phone empty -> (307) 745-2300.
flags: WATERFRONT lead (not changed): FS says '10 of those sites along the banks of the North Fork of the Little Laramie River'; rec.gov 'Some sites lie along the river banks'. No site numbers are given and rec.gov has no Proximity to Water attribute; on Esri imagery the loops sit on an open meadow bench along FR 101 and the river is not visible (hidden under the spruce west/south of the loops; DEM gives no clear channel). At this elevation the North Fork is well under 30 m wide, so the most it could earn is creekside for named sites. Default down: 'not waterfront' kept; the west-edge sites (11, 16, 27, 29-31, 39-41, 51, 53) are where an official site map could prove creekside.

SEASON: stored closes '09-19' (derived from the rec.gov calendar edge) cleared - it marks the end of the reservable Peak season; the 2026 rate table has a first-come season to 10-13 and another from 05-26. The FS page shows 'Site Closed' (seasonal) with no dates.
ALERT: 2026 timber operations on Sand Lake Road / Little Laramie trail system list North Fork Campground as an affected site (alert to Dec 31, 2026) - not a closure.
PHONE: empty -> (307) 745-2300 (rec.gov facility phone and the FS alert contact - Forest Supervisor's Office).
Pin 41.36100,-106.17150 is in the Center loop near sites 03/04; the 60-site centroid is 41.35957,-106.17131 (~160 m south) - under 250 m, no move. FS point 41.36166,-106.17285.
MIN SITE: smallest catalog RV length is 30 ft (site 11) - every site fits a 23-ft rig.
